name: Michael Whatley
desc: Chair of the Republican National Committee since 2024
summary:
Michael David Whatley (born October 1, 1968) is an American politician and lawyer who was chair of the Republican National Committee from 2024 to 2025. He previously served as chair of the North Carolina Republican Party from 2019 to 2024. 
Whatley earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina, Charlotte, a master's degree from Wake Forest University, and a second master's and a Juris Doctor degree from the University of Notre Dame.
